auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: signed-out visitors can view the public home and sign-in routes only
signed-out visitors opening /workspace, /library, /reports, or /settings see the sign-in screen instead of plan data
a signed-in user can only list, open, edit, export, and print plans owned by that same authenticated user
signing out removes visible access to workspace, library, reports, and settings content until the user signs in again

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: public landing page for Lumen Layouts with navigation to sign in

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: authenticated SVG floor-planning canvas with plan switcher, library panel, inspector, history controls, pan, zoom, save, and keyboard alternatives

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: authenticated fixture catalog with selectable fixture details

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: authenticated plan summary preview with export and print controls

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: authenticated account settings and sign out

states.loading: signing in status while authentication is pending
states.validation: email must look like an email and password is required

states.empty: no plans yet message with create plan control
states.error: saving failed, try again message is visible
states.loading: loading plans message while owned plans are read
states.success: saved status appears with the active plan name
states.validation: plan name is required before create is enabled

states.empty: empty canvas prompt invites dragging or keyboard-adding a fixture
states.error: fixture update failed message is visible
states.loading: canvas grid skeleton while the active plan loads
states.success: selected fixture outline and inspector values update visibly
states.validation: brightness accepts 0 through 100 and rotation accepts numeric degrees

states.error: library could not be displayed message
states.success: fixture detail panel appears for the selected fixture
states.validation: a fixture must be selected before details are shown

states.empty: select or create a plan to report on message
states.error: report generation failed message is visible
states.success: exported status or print-ready status appears with the active plan name
states.validation: export and print controls are disabled until a plan is selected

states.error: settings action failed message is visible
states.success: signed out state returns to the sign-in screen
states.validation: sign out requires a signed-in session

summary: An authenticated SVG floor-planning workspace for Lumen Layouts where users create durable plans, edit fixtures on a pan and zoom canvas, undo and redo changes, switch plans, export a summary, and print it.

deferred.reason: the request requires user-owned durable plans but does not request real-time collaboration

deferred.item: importing external CAD, DWG, DXF, or image floor plan files
deferred.reason: the request only requires an interactive SVG planning workspace, export, and print
brightness editing is required as plan data, but physical rendering calculations are not requested

deferred.item: third-party print or export service integration
deferred.reason: the fixed scaffold supports local download and print behavior without additional providers

entities.name: session
relationships: a session represents the current platform authentication state and is not persisted as application data

entities.name: plan
relationships: a plan belongs to the signed-in user
a plan stores many fixture records inside its fixtures array
only the signed-in owner can list, open, update, export, or print their plans

steps.action: open the workspace while signed out
steps.expect: a sign-in screen is visible with email and password fields and the Lumen Layouts name

steps.action: sign up or sign in with email and password
steps.expect: the workspace route is visible with an empty plans panel and a create plan control

steps.action: create and name a new plan
steps.expect: the plan name Gallery Lighting Plan appears in the workspace header and in the plan switcher

steps.action: pan and zoom the SVG canvas
steps.expect: the canvas grid position changes and the visible zoom indicator shows the updated zoom level

steps.action: drag a fixture from the library onto the canvas
steps.expect: a Pendant Light fixture appears inside the SVG canvas with a selected outline

steps.action: select the fixture and edit its inspector values
steps.expect: the selected SVG fixture moves to the edited position, rotates to 45 degrees, and shows brightness 70 in the inspector

steps.action: undo the inspector edit and redo it
steps.expect: the first click reverts the fixture values and the second click restores x 240, y 160, rotation 45, and brightness 70

steps.action: save the plan
steps.expect: a saved status is visible for Gallery Lighting Plan

steps.action: reload
steps.expect: Gallery Lighting Plan reloads with the same fixture, inspector values, pan position, and zoom level visible

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates, edits, saves, and reloads a floor plan
acceptance: a saved plan made in the browser survives a full page reload
the SVG canvas visibly reflects pan, zoom, fixture position, rotation, and brightness changes
undo and redo visibly revert and restore the last fixture edit

steps.action: open the workspace
steps.expect: the saved Gallery Lighting Plan is visible in the workspace header

steps.action: move keyboard focus to the fixture library and choose a fixture type
steps.expect: the Wall Sconce library item has a visible focus outline and selected state

steps.action: activate the keyboard add control for the selected fixture
steps.expect: a Wall Sconce fixture appears on the SVG canvas and becomes selected

steps.action: move keyboard focus to the X position field
steps.expect: the X position field has a visible focus outline

steps.action: enter keyboard position values for the selected fixture
steps.expect: the inspector shows x 300 and y 220 and the selected fixture moves on the SVG canvas

journeys.title: A keyboard user adds and adjusts a fixture without dragging
acceptance: a fixture can be added from the library without using drag and drop
keyboard-entered position changes are reflected in both the inspector and the SVG canvas

steps.action: open the workspace
steps.expect: the plan switcher lists Gallery Lighting Plan

steps.action: create and name a second plan
steps.expect: Lobby Fixture Plan appears as the active plan and is listed in the plan switcher

steps.action: switch back to the first plan
steps.expect: Gallery Lighting Plan becomes the workspace header and its saved fixture is visible on the canvas

steps.action: switch to the second plan
steps.expect: Lobby Fixture Plan becomes the workspace header and its empty canvas is visible

journeys.title: A user creates a second plan and switches between durable plans
acceptance: each plan has its own visible canvas state
switching plans does not overwrite the other plan's fixtures

steps.action: open the library route
steps.expect: the fixture library page is visible with Pendant Light, Wall Sconce, Track Head, and Recessed Downlight options

steps.action: select a library fixture for details
steps.expect: the Track Head detail panel is visible with a description and default brightness

journeys.title: A user opens the separate fixture library route
acceptance: the library route is separate from the workspace route
selecting a fixture displays its readable details

steps.action: open the reports route
steps.expect: a report preview for Gallery Lighting Plan is visible with the plan name and fixture count

steps.action: download the plan summary
steps.expect: a downloadable summary file is produced and the page shows an exported status for Gallery Lighting Plan

steps.action: print the plan summary
steps.expect: the page shows a print-ready status for Gallery Lighting Plan

journeys.title: A user exports and prints a plan summary
acceptance: the report preview includes the selected plan name and fixture count
export produces an observable downloadable summary result
print shows an observable print-ready status

steps.action: open the settings route
steps.expect: the settings page is visible with account information and a sign out control

steps.action: sign out
steps.expect: the sign-in screen is visible and workspace navigation requires authentication again

journeys.title: A signed-in user opens the settings route
acceptance: signing out hides authenticated workspace content

acceptance.statement: a signed-out visitor opening /workspace is shown a sign-in screen instead of plan data
a plan created and saved in the browser is readable after a full page reload with the same fixture and canvas values
dragging or keyboard-adding a fixture creates a visible SVG fixture and selects it for inspector editing
undo visibly reverts the last fixture edit and redo visibly restores it
switching between two plans shows each plan's own stored canvas state without overwriting the other
the reports route shows a summary for the active plan and the export control produces an observable downloadable result
the print control shows a print-ready status for the active plan summary
signing out from settings returns the browser to a sign-in screen and hides authenticated workspace content
